convert_logits_to_probabilities: convert model logits output to corner probability tensor using sigmoid or softmax
reshape_depth_to_space: reshape corner probability tensor from cell format to full image spatial dimensions
detect_keypoints_with_nms: detect corner keypoints from probability map using non-maximum suppression and thresholding
create_label_map_from_positions: create a binary label map tensor from a list of keypoint coordinate positions
extract_positions_with_probabilities: extract keypoint positions and their probabilities from a probability map tensor
